title: Kettle & Crumb discount review
brief:
I'm Niamh Gallagher and I just reviewed pull request 884 at Kettle & Crumb, an online bakery, from Tomás Velasco, dated 2026-10-22. Make me a page for Tomás to read at his desk on a laptop, where each note sits on the exact line it is about and carries a severity: blocker, major, minor or nit. Under "Code under review" show this code with line numbers:
1 def apply_discount(cart, code, today):
2     promo = PROMOS.get(code)
3     if promo is None:
4         return cart
5     if promo['expires'] <= today:
6         return cart
7     total = 0
8     for item in cart.items:
9         price = item.price * item.qty
10        if item.category in promo['categories']:
11            price = price * (1 - promo['percent'] / 100)
12        total += price
13    cart.total = total
14    if promo['uses'] > 0:
15        promo['uses'] -= 1
16    return cart
Under "Review notes", tie these to their lines: line 14, blocker, a code with 0 uses left still gives the discount, because the check only guards the decrement; line 11, major, money is calculated with fractions and never rounded to cents; line 15, major, two checkouts at the same moment can both take the last use; line 5, minor, a code that expires today is rejected because the comparison is not strict; line 2, nit, codes are case sensitive, so save10 fails where SAVE10 works. Under "Summary": 1 blocker, 2 major, 1 minor, 1 nit, and the verdict: changes requested.

edit.request: Add a minor note on line 8 saying an empty cart is not handled, and change the summary counts to 1 blocker, 2 major, 2 minor, 1 nit.
